text:
laura: FYI — OrionCloud just pinged: one of the containers in the Feb 10 shipment got re-manifested, so ~40% of the reserved GPUs are now in a separate ETA window. We need to decide if we patch customers or reallocate.

mike: ugh. Do we have exact SKUs + qty split? This impacts Dedicated commits for two customers.

laura: vendor sent the manifest diff: `rtx-6000 x48`, `rtx-8000 x32` moved to later vessel. Total for our Feb 10 resv drops from 160 -> 80 usable on original ETA.

jin: Can we borrow buffer from the week-1 committed pool in APAC? We still have ~24 spare in the transit buffer but that burns our safety cushion.

sophia: if we shift from committed to burst for affected customers they'll see degraded SLOs. Need CS signoff and a credits plan. @andrea any quick thoughts from partner side?

andrea: talking to OrionCloud ops now. They offered consolidation via airlift for the 32 units at extra cost — needs approval by EOD from our procurement team. Also asked if we can accept split delivery and start routing 48 units to EU customers that don't require immediate onprem installs.

laura: ok decision tree:
1) Accept split delivery, reroute 48 -> EU (low-risk).
2) Approve airlift for 32 -> covers critical Dedicated nodes (cost +$45k).
3) Borrow transit buffer (24) and issue partial credits for 16 units shortfall.

mike: prefer 1+2 if procurement approves. Can finance fast-track the airlift PO?

orion-bot: Shipping update: AWB 987-XY re-booked. ETA alt vessel Mar 4; airlift ETA Feb 18 if PO confirmed.

sophia: I'm looping in finance now. I'll draft a customer message template for partial reroute and credits.

jin: also recommending we tweak reservation smoothing in the marketplace: increase safety buffer to 20% for next two quarters and auto-notify customers at 7d lead instead of 3d. Small policy YAML snippet:
```
reservation_policy:
  safety_buffer_pct: 20
  notify_lead_days: 7
```

andrea: partner agrees to preferential consolidation if we sign amended SLA addendum to cover airlift costs that exceed our cap.

laura: action items: andrea to get PO estimate from OrionCloud; sophia to draft customer comms; finance to approve airlift by 16:00 PT; jin to push temp reservation policy change. We'll revisit in 30m.

mike: :thumbsup: thanks team — let's avoid surprises for customers this week.
